title: feat(panel): implement collapsed feature

comments.body:
Deploy preview for *instantsearchjs* ready!

Built with commit 94c06c21c062d2ebe6268c9f901c4e4ca87d09ee

https://deploy-preview-3575--instantsearchjs.netlify.com

@samouss Follow up on https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3575#discussion_r262019992, I added two templates:

- `collapseButtonMore`
- `collapseButtonLess`

Note that it inserts `span`s in the `button` now.

Let me know if you have other ideas for these template names.

**Edit**: the templates are merged in the template `collapseButtonText`.
@Haroenv I updated the spec in algolia/instantsearch-specs#99.
